items.text: Weekend FF reports summary: Not expected - McConkey, Caleb Williams, Dowdle, MHJ, Slayton, Palmer. GTD - Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, McLaurin, DJ Moore. Expected - Flowers, Tate, Stevenson, Kamara, Keenan Allen. Messiest week; no Bengals WR info yet.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for outs like Warren for Dowdle, Wilson for MHJ.

items.text: Vikings WRs Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) both questionable; will work out pregame. Jefferson determined for homecoming.
items.opportunity: If both limited/out, other MIN pass catchers surge.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot), no practice this week and questionable, is not expected to play vs Broncos.
items.why: Did not practice all week with foot injury.
items.implication: Sit in all formats; targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston or other LAC WRs elevated targets/routes.

items.text: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle (toe/foot) unlikely to play vs Colts; final call in warmups but team cautious.
items.why: Toe injury; limited practice; risk of aggravation.
items.implication: Jaylen Warren workhorse RB1 upside again.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (plantar fasciitis/ankle) hopeful to play but not definite; will work out pregame. LV elevated RB in case.
items.opportunity: If out, elevated backup RB volume.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; he will be inactive vs Lions as details finalized. Texans remain team to watch.
items.why: Trade imminent; team informed him morning of inactive.
items.implication: No fantasy production Week 5; long-term value shift post-trade.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson role expansion in ARI offense.

items.text: Chargers QB Justin Herbert faces challenges with Slater and Alt out; expected to start four rookies on OL vs Broncos. Six straight games without more TDs than INTs.
items.implication: Herbert and pass catchers capped; pressure risk high.
items.opportunity: DEN defense upside; LAC RBs possibly more involved.

items.text: Jayden Daniels returning from elbow injury but doctors around NFL believe it's when not if he hurts left elbow again.
items.why: Return confirmed; medical concern on recurrence.
items.implication: Start but monitor; high reinjury risk.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (foot), listed questionable, is expected to play vs Falcons SNF.
items.implication: Startable WR2 even with Huntley at QB; volume remains.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) expected to play vs Vikings.
Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) expected to play vs Raiders.
MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. Post-inactive/trade: Kia Kendrick Bourne szn / Wilson season. Mazda Marv joke continues.
items.why: Low production/impact data; trade opens door.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 in ARI; target share surge.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume including red-zone with MHJ out/trade.
Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume/red-zone hog vs soft Titans secondary.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; gobbles targets/fantasy points, usage/matchup strong especially if CIN WRs limited.
items.why: Workload and soft run D; Bengals injury boost.

items.text: Hates Cam Skattebo @ WSH as RB20; efficiency and game environment concerns.
items.implication: Fade or sit if better options.
items.conflict: Rapoport notes expect LOT of Skattebo volume.

items.text: Hates Jalen Hurts vs JAX (London) as QB15; rough stretch and banged-up line.
Loves Isaiah Likely TE5 and Christian Watson WR15; specific coverage/positional weaknesses and usage.
